en: Tinted historic street view showing a long straight road lined with low buildings on the left and a wall with trees on the right. In the distance stands a church tower with a dome and cross. Pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the street. Printed text at the top identifies the scene as a street and the Tower of St. Spiridon in Iași. A website watermark appears at the bottom right.
